item.title: Today, we announced a new go-to hub for your health and wellness, plus a brand new wearable. 💪 The Google Health app combines everything you know a...
item.description:
Today, we announced a new go-to hub for your health and wellness, plus a brand new wearable.
💪 The Google Health app combines everything you know and love about the Fitbit experience with  advanced new capabilities and better insights, so you can understand the "why" behind your health trends. It’s free to use and integrates with hundreds of other apps and devices, like your Peloton or meal-logging apps.
📈 After six months in Public Preview, the Google Health Coach will also start rolling out to Google Health Premium subscribers in the coming weeks, offering even more personalized analysis and suggestions.  Google Health Premium benefits will also be included in Google AI Pro and Ultra plans.
👟 We’re also introducing our first screenless wearable: the Fitbit Air. It’s simple, comfortable and notification-free, with a battery life of up to a week and a variety of band styles for every mood and occasion. Available for pre-order today starting at $99.99.
Learn more about all the updates coming to Google Health →  https://goo.gle/49icyMA
* Works with most phones running on Android 11 or higher and Apple iOS 16.4 or higher. Requires Google Account and Google Health app. Not intended for medical purposes. See g.co/health/fitbit-air for details. * Battery life depends upon many factors and usage and actual battery life may be lower. See g.co/fitbit/battery.

item.title: Last year, we introduced AlphaEvolve, our Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms. Today, it’s helping to discover better, fast...
item.description:
Last year, we introduced AlphaEvolve, our Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms. Today, it’s helping to discover better, faster ways to solve the world's most complex challenges.
Together with Google Cloud, AlphaEvolve is helping scientists and enterprises scale impact across fields like:
• Genomics: Improving the accuracy of DNA sequencing to help scientists find hidden disease-causing mutations more effectively.
• Disaster safety: Improving the prediction of risks like wildfires and floods — helping communities better prepare for natural disasters.
• Energy: Increasing the ability to find feasible power grid solutions, significantly reducing the need for costly post-processing steps for electricity grids.
• Logistics: Optimizing warehouse routing to save distance traveled — helping teams handle higher order volumes with their existing equipment and staff.
Learn more about the impact of AlphaEvolve → https://goo.gle/4u3pUEW

item.title: Welcome to Meadow Point, our newest campus in San Jose, California. It’s home to Google’s Core team, the experts behind the technical infrastructure...
item.description:
Welcome to Meadow Point, our newest campus in San Jose, California. It’s home to Google’s Core team, the experts behind the technical infrastructure and AI-first experiences that keep Google products running smoothly.
We believe great work starts with a great place to do it. This campus features a beautiful meadow courtyard filled with native plants and trees that support local pollinators and provide access to nature 🦋 🐝.
The workspace design pays tribute to San Jose's history as a fishing and boat making hub. It’s a bright, airy space that balances the Bay Area’s coastal vibes with everything you need to get work done.
Take a peek inside and come grow with us → https://goo.gle/3RcGqDU

item.title: This week at YouTube’s Brandcast, Neal Mohan shared the latest YouTube updates for brands, creators and advertisers. See what’s new ⬇️Feeling so i...
item.description:
This week at YouTube’s Brandcast, Neal Mohan shared the latest YouTube updates for brands, creators and advertisers. See what’s new ⬇️Feeling so inspired after another #Brandcast, thanks to the brands, creators and partners who have made YouTube their home.
For decades, the entertainment industry programmed shows based on formulas and focus groups, guessing at what would make an audience show up. At YouTube, we didn't wait for a focus group. We built a stage and empowered anyone with a story to find an audience.
Today, YouTubers are the new stars and studios, making every cultural moment bigger. Whether it’s the Artemis launch, Super Bowl or the Oscars, fans come to YouTube to immerse themselves through the lens of their favorite creators.
None of this happened by accident. For more than two decades, we’ve focused on staying one step ahead of how the world watches. Years ago we predicted people would want to watch YouTube on the biggest screen in their home so we invested in the TV viewing experience. Today, we’ve been #1 in streaming watchtime in the US for 3 years.
We know that to keep viewers coming back, we have to build the best possible home for our creators. That’s why we’ve invested in the infrastructure they need to thrive, from pioneering the creator economy to scaling their reach with auto-dubbing to unlocking AI-powered video creation tools.
For advertisers, the modern marketing playbook has been rewritten. How they build a brand and deliver performance has completely shifted. With YouTube, they can tap into trust, partner with creators to unlock huge ROI, and use the most advanced AI in the world to drive results like never before.
On top of all of this: for the first time at Brandcast, we brought them an inside look into our new slate of YouTube-exclusive Creator Shows, all of which can be sponsored. The biggest names in media are officially recognizing YouTube as their primary network.
A huge thank you to our host Trevor Noah, to Zara Larsson and Chappell Roan for unforgettable performances, to the creators and partners who joined us on-stage and in the audience, and to our amazing YouTube team who brought the show to life.
The future of media is being built on YouTube, and the most exciting part is that we’re just getting started.
